name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Push through your heels to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees, then lower with control.
coaching_cue: Squeeze your glutes hard at the top and avoid pushing through your lower back.
common_mistakes: Overarching the lower back at the top, pushing through toes instead of heels, not fully extending the hips.
modification: Reduce range of motion — don't lift as high.
advanced_progression: Single-leg glute bridge or add a dumbbell across your hips.

name: Bodyweight Hip Hinge
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, hands on your hips. Push your hips back while keeping a flat back, lowering your torso until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then stand tall by squeezing your glutes.
coaching_cue: Imagine closing a car door with your hips — push them straight back. Keep a slight knee bend.
common_mistakes: Rounding the back, bending the knees too much (turning it into a squat), not hinging deep enough.
modification: Hold a broomstick along your spine to learn proper alignment.
advanced_progression: Add dumbbells for a Romanian deadlift.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs. Hinge at the hips, sliding the weights down along your legs while keeping your back flat. Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand.
coaching_cue: The weights should stay close to your legs the entire time. Think about pushing the floor away as you stand.
common_mistakes: Rounding the back, locking the knees completely, letting the weights drift forward.
modification: Use lighter weights and reduce range of motion.
advanced_progression: Single-leg Romanian deadlift or heavier weights.

name: Kettlebell Deadlift
instructions: Stand over a kettlebell with feet hip-width apart. Hinge at the hips, grip the handle, brace your core, and stand tall by driving through your feet. Reverse the movement to lower the weight.
coaching_cue: Pack your shoulders down and back before you lift. The arms are just hooks — your legs and hips do the work.
common_mistakes: Rounding the back, squatting the weight up instead of hinging, jerking the weight off the floor.
modification: Use a lighter kettlebell or dumbbell held vertically.
low_impact_alternative: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift with lighter weight.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent. Extend one leg straight up or hold it off the floor. Press through the grounded foot to lift your hips, then lower with control.
coaching_cue: Keep your hips level — don't let the unsupported side drop.
common_mistakes: Hips rotating, not fully extending at the top, using momentum.
modification: Standard glute bridge with both feet down.
advanced_progression: Add a dumbbell on the working hip.

name: Banded Good Morning
instructions: Stand on a resistance band with feet hip-width apart, loop the other end behind your neck. Hinge at the hips with a flat back until your torso is roughly parallel to the floor, then stand tall.
coaching_cue: Keep a soft bend in the knees and feel the stretch in your hamstrings as you hinge forward.
common_mistakes: Rounding the back, bending the knees too much, snapping up quickly.
modification: Bodyweight hip hinge without the band.
advanced_progression: Use a heavier band or hold a dumbbell behind the neck.
